**Last updated: 10 October 2026**

This policy covers sisengai.com and the services behind it: the free website brief, the chat that follows it, and the Job Seeker Studio. It also covers one personal app that is not a SisengAI service.

## What this site does

Two things, and neither needs an account.

**The website brief.** You give a website address. The service fetches the public pages of that site, reads them, and reports on the offer, the audience, the clarity, and one practical AI opportunity. You can then ask follow-up questions about those pages.

**The Job Seeker Studio.** You upload a CV. The studio reads it, shows you what it found, and can generate tailored application files from it.

## What is stored, and for how long

**The website brief and the chat that follows it**

- The website address you enter, the public pages fetched from it, and the questions you ask.
- A research session is kept for **24 hours**, then deleted. A cached copy of a site's pages is kept for **5 minutes**.
- **Your chat messages are not stored.** Nothing you type in the conversation is written to the database.
- If you type an email address into the chat, the service saves your name, email and message so it can follow up with you.

**The Job Seeker Studio**

- Your CV and the files you generate are held in a private workspace tied to your browser. There is no account and no email step.
- A workspace is deleted after **30 days without activity**.
- To read the parts of a CV that are hard to parse, the CV text is sent to an AI service, TypeSafe, which returns labels for it. We keep no copy of it beyond your own workspace and do not use it to train models.

**The contact form**

- Your name, email, subject and message are sent to us and delivered to us by email.
- The form also carries a hidden field that a real visitor never sees or fills in. It exists only to catch spam bots.
- Submissions are rate-limited by IP address. That counter is held in memory only and is never written to disk.

## Analytics

The website uses **self-hosted GoatCounter** to count page views and show aggregate site-usage statistics. It runs on SisengAI’s own server; page-view data is stored there, not sent to a third-party analytics provider. GoatCounter does not use cookies, browser storage or persistent tracking identifiers. The server briefly processes an IP address and browser information to calculate aggregate statistics, but does not store the IP address or full browser header in the analytics database.

## What this site does not do

- **No third-party analytics, advertising or tracking cookies.** There is no Google Analytics, no tag manager, no advertising pixel and no session recorder on any page. The first-party, self-hosted page counter is described above.
- **No account, no login, no newsletter.**
- **We do not sell your data.**

## Where AI fits in

Reading a website or a CV, and answering your questions, uses AI models. The text involved — the pages fetched for your brief, your questions, or your CV — is sent to a model service to produce the result. It is sent to do that job and nothing else.

## Your choices

- To have anything you have sent deleted, email Ricky.Macharm@SisengAI.com.
- Research sessions and workspaces delete themselves on the schedule above. You do not have to ask.
- Because there is no account, there is nothing to log out of.

## Personal apps

The following is a separate, personal app. It is not a SisengAI service, and SisengAI does not run it or hold its data.

**Personal rclone Backup**

This is a personal backup app that runs rclone on my laptop. It syncs files from my local Documents folder to the Tuxedo/Documents folder in my Google Drive.

The script uses Google Drive to compare and transfer files. Its Google permission is broad Drive access, although this backup script is configured to sync only the folder named above. Because it uses sync, it can update or remove files in that destination folder to match the local source.

The files are transferred directly between my laptop and my Google Drive. The OAuth authorization token is kept in rclone's local configuration. SisengAI does not receive or store the backup files.

The files in Google Drive are subject to Google's policies and settings. I can stop the backup or revoke the app's access from my Google Account.

For questions about this personal app, contact ricky.macharm@gmail.com.
